purpose: Teach: スナップ/ソックス/メッシュ/１番/合コン/酔っ払っ/愛嬌/おしっこ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが運動会のスナップ写真を撮って下さったわよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad took some lovely photos of you at the sports day.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact delivery. Opening on the child's name with gentle attention. Natural pace, conversational. Slight warmth on the word 'dad.' This is the kind of thing she mentions in passing because she knows he'll care.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに新しいソックスを買って頂いたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad bought me these new socks.
lines.style: Quiet pride in the delivery. A small, genuine smile underneath the words. Child-careful with the detail — it matters to him that it was from Dad. No performance, just something he wanted to share.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがメッシュのキャップを買って下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your father bought you that mesh cap you wanted.
lines.style: Gentle, observant tone. She's noticing the pattern he's noticing — how his father shows up. Slight warmth on 'father,' no sing-song. Calm, matter-of-fact on the object.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに「１番大事なのは家族」って教えて頂いたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad taught me that the most important thing is family.
lines.style: Serious, holding the weight of what he's saying. No rushing — he wants this to land. Small child voice but earnest in the bone. Slight pause after 'family' — he believes it.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「合コンには行かない」って若い頃から仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father's been saying since he was young that he doesn't go to those meet-ups.
lines.style: Dry amusement underneath. Not unkind — almost fond. A knowing glance at what that choice means. Matter-of-fact delivery with a tiny lift of irony, like she's in on the joke of his devotion.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんが「酔っ払っちゃダメ」って仰ったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad told me you shouldn't drink too much.
lines.style: Child-careful repetition of something Dad said. Not lecturing — just passing it on. Small, earnest voice. Slight hesitation, like he's making sure he gets it right because it came from Dad.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「愛嬌は何よりの武器」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father always says charm is your best weapon.
lines.style: Reflective, almost philosophical in delivery. She's thinking about what this means, what she wants him to understand. Slower pace. Warmth on 'charm,' gentle conviction. Not teaching — musing, in his hearing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに「おしっこは我慢しちゃダメ」って教えて頂いたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad taught me that you shouldn't hold it in when you need to go to the bathroom.
lines.style: Earnest child stating a practical lesson as though it carries real weight. Small, sincere voice. No embarrassment — Dad said it, so it matters. Slight breathiness on the longer phrase, natural for a young child.
